correctness.rationale: Exact quotient neighbourhood multisets are proved for all integer m at least 4. The first three partitions and induction correctly identify two boundary waves; a 4-cycle-count argument gives the full dihedral automorphism stabilizer. The last split occurs at max(3,floor(m/2)); finite independent direct and quotient checkers corroborate all boundary cases.
